note: Point edits of the mouse body (README, "Point edits"). pnpm glb-point-edits assets/models/mouse/mouse-edits.json writes mouse.rig.glb from the file of the base commit, and pnpm studio-body mouse then writes src/models/studio/mouse.ts. The keys are vertex indices of the primitive fur, and the moves are in the stored space of the file (the bind).

groups.name: eye_R
groups.note: Four fur vertices of the head at the inner side of the right pea eye (eye_R, the left eye in the front view), 0.03 to 0.09 H from its middle, move into the head along the axis of the eye by 0.025, 0.015, 0.015, and 0.01 H (H: the head height of the pea eyes, 0.3173 units). In the front view, a face of the old eye socket covered a notch of the inner side of the oval.
